COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Career Opportunities and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
